nodes.name: audit.py
nodes.summary: Central audit-trail module providing before/after change-logging helper functions for every mutable entity type in the SoA workbench (visits, activities, elements, timings, schedule timelines, instances, amendments, organizations, roles, persons, and more), each writing a row to the entity's audit table using the supplied database cursor.
nodes.languageNotes: Highly repetitive by design: each of the 30+ functions follows the identical (soa_id, action, entity_id, before, after) signature so callers can log mutations uniformly across the whole domain model.

nodes.summary: Records a before/after audit-trail entry for an arm mutation (soa_id, action, ...), inserting a row into the corresponding audit table.

nodes.name: activities.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI router for Activity CRUD, bulk creation, and reordering, plus CDISC Biomedical Concept fetching/association and the DSS (Dataset Specialization) and CRF specialization cell rendering used by the SoA matrix UI.

nodes.name: fetch_biomedical_concepts
nodes.summary: Fetches and caches the CDISC Library Biomedical Concepts list, falling back to a local CDISC_CONCEPTS_JSON override file when set, and normalizes the various API response shapes into a flat list of concept dicts.

nodes.name: list_activities
nodes.summary: API endpoint returning all activitys for the given SoA as JSON.

nodes.name: get_activity
nodes.summary: API endpoint returning a single activity by ID.

nodes.name: _next_activity_uid
nodes.summary: Computes the next monotonic Activity_N UID by scanning existing activity rows for the SoA.

nodes.name: add_activity
nodes.summary: API endpoint that validates and inserts a new activity for the SoA, assigning its UID and recording an audit entry.

nodes.name: ui_add_activity
nodes.summary: HTMX form handler that creates a new activity from submitted form fields and returns the refreshed partial.

nodes.name: update_activity
nodes.summary: API endpoint that validates and applies changes to an existing activity, recording before/after audit state.

nodes.name: ui_update_activity
nodes.summary: HTMX form handler that updates an existing activity from submitted form fields and returns the refreshed partial.

nodes.name: reorder_activities_api
nodes.summary: API endpoint that persists a new display order for activitys and records a reorder audit entry.

nodes.name: add_activities_bulk
nodes.summary: API endpoint that creates multiple activities in one request from a newline-delimited names payload.

nodes.name: set_activity_concepts
nodes.summary: API endpoint that replaces an activity's associated Biomedical Concept codes, upserting Code/BiomedicalConcept rows and scheduling background enrichment tasks.

nodes.name: _reindex_activities
nodes.summary: Renumbers activity display_order values contiguously after a deletion or reorder.

nodes.name: ui_list_activities
nodes.summary: Renders the full Activities page, including CDISC concept status, DSS/CRF cell state, and drag-to-reorder controls.

nodes.name: ui_refresh_concepts_activities
nodes.summary: Triggers a manual refresh of the cached CDISC Biomedical Concepts list from the Activities UI and re-renders the page.

nodes.name: ui_create_activity
nodes.summary: HTMX form handler that creates a new activity from submitted form fields and returns the refreshed partial.

nodes.name: ui_delete_activity_page
nodes.summary: HTMX handler that deletes a activity and returns the updated partial.

nodes.name: _render_dss_cell
nodes.summary: Renders the Dataset Specialization (DSS) assignment cell HTMX partial for an activity, showing currently linked DSS entries.

nodes.name: ui_dss_options
nodes.summary: Returns DSS option choices for a given Biomedical Concept code to populate the DSS assignment dropdown.

nodes.name: ui_save_dss_assignment
nodes.summary: Saves a DSS (Dataset Specialization) selection for an activity/concept pair and records an audit entry.

nodes.name: ui_delete_dss_assignment
nodes.summary: Removes a DSS assignment row from an activity and records an audit entry.

nodes.name: ui_dss_detail
nodes.summary: Renders the full CDISC Library DSS specialization detail page for a given href, fetching and formatting variable-level metadata.

nodes.name: _render_crf_cell
nodes.summary: Renders the CRF specialization assignment cell HTMX partial for an activity.

nodes.name: ui_crf_options
nodes.summary: Returns CRF specialization option choices for a Biomedical Concept code.

nodes.name: ui_save_crf_assignment
nodes.summary: Saves a CRF specialization selection for an activity/concept pair and records an audit entry.

nodes.name: ui_delete_crf_assignment
nodes.summary: Removes a CRF specialization assignment from an activity and records an audit entry.

nodes.name: ui_crf_detail_from_activity
nodes.summary: Renders the CRF specialization detail page reached from an activity's assignment cell.

nodes.name: bc_surrogates.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI router managing BC (Biomedical Concept) Surrogate entities and their links to activities, including the concepts-cell HTMX partial that renders surrogate/BC assignments in the SoA matrix.

nodes.name: _next_surrogate_uid
nodes.summary: Computes the next monotonic BCSurrogate_N UID by scanning existing surrogate rows for the SoA.

nodes.name: list_bc_surrogates
nodes.summary: API endpoint returning all BC surrogates for the given SoA as JSON.

nodes.name: create_bc_surrogate
nodes.summary: API endpoint that validates and inserts a new BC surrogate for the SoA, assigning its UID and recording an audit entry.

nodes.name: update_bc_surrogate
nodes.summary: API endpoint that validates and applies changes to an existing BC surrogate, recording before/after audit state.

nodes.name: delete_bc_surrogate
nodes.summary: API endpoint that deletes a BC surrogate and records an audit entry.

nodes.name: link_surrogate_to_activity
nodes.summary: Helper function supporting BC surrogate handling in this router.

nodes.name: unlink_surrogate_from_activity
nodes.summary: Helper function supporting BC surrogate handling in this router.

nodes.name: ui_create_bc_surrogate
nodes.summary: HTMX form handler that creates a new BC surrogate from submitted form fields and returns the refreshed partial.

nodes.name: ui_update_bc_surrogate
nodes.summary: HTMX form handler that updates an existing BC surrogate from submitted form fields and returns the refreshed partial.

nodes.name: ui_delete_bc_surrogate
nodes.summary: HTMX handler that deletes a BC surrogate and returns the updated partial.

nodes.name: _render_concepts_cell
nodes.summary: Renders the Concepts/Surrogates HTMX cell partial for an activity, listing linked Biomedical Concepts and BC Surrogates in the SoA matrix.

nodes.name: ui_add_surrogate_to_activity
nodes.summary: HTMX form handler that creates a new BC surrogate from submitted form fields and returns the refreshed partial.

nodes.name: ui_remove_surrogate_from_activity
nodes.summary: Helper function supporting BC surrogate handling in this router.

nodes.name: update_study_cell

nodes.name: delete_study_cell
nodes.summary: API endpoint that deletes a study cell and records an audit entry.

nodes.name: ui_list_study_cells
nodes.summary: Renders the study cells list/section HTMX partial for the SoA UI page.

nodes.name: ui_create_study_cell
nodes.summary: HTMX form handler that creates a new study cell from submitted form fields and returns the refreshed partial.

nodes.name: ui_update_study_cell
nodes.summary: HTMX form handler that updates an existing study cell from submitted form fields and returns the refreshed partial.

nodes.name: ui_delete_study_cell
nodes.summary: HTMX handler that deletes a study cell and returns the updated partial.
